name: When is the best time for post-remodel finish painting?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time for post-remodel finish painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal time for post-remodel finish painting is after all other construction trades have completed their work and all dust and debris have been removed. This includes plumbing, electrical, and carpentry. Painting should occur before floor installation to protect new flooring, but after any major drywall or plaster work has fully cured. This sequence minimizes damage to new paint and ensures a smooth, clean surface for application.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best time for post-remodel finish painting is after all other construction work and cleanup are complete, but before new flooring is installed.
